summary: CH.3 Frontend (Swiss Tax Profile hub + wizard + activation gate + history) tested end-to-end with persona_finance and persona_junior. All specified data-testids are present and wired correctly. Navigation, hub badges, wizard flow (all 6 steps for taxable + skip flow for 'Je ne sais pas'), live UID validation (3 cases), Why popovers, permission enforcement (junior 403 surfaced as friendly toast), sidebar attention dot in flyout and 'TVA' label — all pass. Two UX friction issues found related to effective_from handling and completeness recomputation on edit.

minor.issue: Returns 409 with technical detail when the draft has the same effective_from as an already-published version. Detail string is surfaced as-is in the toast (visible French but a bit technical). Consider a friendlier message when the wizard reuses the existing active date.

ui_bugs.issue: On edit, prefill.effective_from = active.effective_from. Submitting without changing the date always triggers a 409 on publish (append-only immutable). Users see a red toast even when they only wanted to fix a missing field on the current period. The wizard should either (a) auto-bump the effective_from to today or next available date, or (b) allow the backend to append a NEW published version with same effective_from (or treat as amendment).

When user picks a future effective_from (e.g. 2027-07-15) to avoid the 409, publish succeeds and history correctly lists the new version, BUT the hub still shows the old badge 'À compléter' because GET /tax-profile is filtered by as_of=today. There is no visual hint to the user that their new configuration is scheduled and will only become active later. Consider adding a 'Prochaine configuration à partir du …' banner when a future published version exists.

Company step: country FR label 'Suisse' (locked), canton pre-filled to 'GE' (Genève), currency 'CHF · Franc suisse'

action_items: Handle wizard-edit collision on effective_from: auto-bump default to next valid date OR allow amendment / show clearer message on 409

Add a 'configuration future planifiée' banner on the hub when a published version with effective_from > today exists (so the user isn't confused by an unchanged 'À compléter' badge after a successful save)
critical_code_review_comments: Wizard prefill sets effective_from = prefill.effective_from | `${currentYear}-01-01`. Since tax profile is append-only immutable, using the existing active date guarantees a 409 on republish — either the frontend must offer a fresh date or the backend must allow the amendment/replacement semantics implicit in the UI copy 'Modifier la configuration'.
The hub only reads active-as-of-today. If publish succeeds with a future date, the UI gives no feedback that the change is scheduled — the user might think nothing happened.
Error toast on publish uses response.data.detail verbatim; consider mapping 409 to a specific human-readable message.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all specified test-ids and flows work; two UX gaps around effective_from and future scheduled config)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids from the CH.3 review request are wired and verified. The two remaining findings are product-UX decisions, not implementation defects; the main agent can decide whether to (a) auto-advance effective_from, (b) allow same-date amendment on the backend, or (c) surface a 'planifié' banner. Junior 403 handling is production-quality (friendly French toast).
rca of the issue: 409 on republish stems from the immutable append-only rule combined with the wizard prefilling effective_from from the currently active version. Reproduction: (1) login persona_finance, (2) navigate ACCOUNTING → TVA, (3) click 'Compléter' or 'Modifier', (4) go through steps without changing the date, (5) submit → 409. Mitigation options: bump default date in Wizard (line 77 SwissTaxProfile.js: `effective_from: prefill?.effective_from || \`${currentYear}-01-01\`` → use today or +1 day when a version already exists at that date), or introduce an 'amend current' backend endpoint that supersedes without a new period start.
